# 0 · Setup

```{r package-setup}
# Data wrangling and visualisation
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(gt)
library(patchwork)

# Data import
library(midphysac)
```

## Variables

```{r variables}
# A2PA used as the sole predictor for the whole poster
x <- c(
  "A2PA" = "A2PA"

# Outcomes compared between A2PA groups

  "MMSE" = "MMSE",
  "GDS-15" = "GDS15",

  "GAI-SF" = "GAI",
  "Prob. anxiety" = "Anx",
  "FAQ" = "FAQ",
  "Mental activities" = "Total_MA",
  "Subj. health" =  "Health",
  "RAVLR-DR" = "Delayed_recall_raw",
  "z(RAVLT-DR)" = "Delayed_recall_z",
  "TMT-B" = "TMT_B_raw",
  "z(TMT-B)" = "TMT_B_z",
  "BNT-30" = "BNT_30_raw",
  "z(BNT-30)" = "BNT_30_z",

```

## Data

```{r data-import}
# NOTE: data live in a freeze artifact at OSF
raw_data <- midphysac::read_poster_data()

# NOTE: data are trimmed at A2PA < 4 for this analysis
df <- dplyr::filter(raw_data, A2PA <= "Active")
```
